description: This Java test class, DateValidationTest, contains integration tests that validate date handling logic within the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for invalid date formats, invalid date-time strings, and date-related validation errors during operations like client creation, loan application, and fixed deposit application. The class leverages JUnit 5 and REST-assured for testing REST APIs, and it interacts with the Fineract APIs to verify date validation scenarios.

classes.name: DateValidationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs integration testing for date validation logic in the Fineract project, including tests for invalid date formats, date-time validation, and date range validations during client and deposit operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured configuration, request and response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testShouldFailIfDateIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests that creating a loan with an invalid disbursement date in an incorrect format results in an appropriate validation error.

methods.name: testShouldFailWithInvalidDateTime
methods.description: Tests that a transaction request with an invalid expiration datetime produces the expected validation error.

methods.name: testShouldFailWithInvalidMonthDay
methods.description: Validates that providing an invalid month and day in date parameters (e.g., June 31st) results in the correct validation error when applying for a fixed deposit.

methods.name: buildRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs a JSON payload for interoperation transaction requests, including date format, expiration, and other parameters.

methods.name: createFixedDepositProduct
methods.description: Helper to create a fixed deposit product with specified validity dates and accounting accounts.

methods.name: applyForFixedDepositApplication
methods.description: Helper to apply for a fixed deposit account with specified parameters including submitted date and charges.

methods.name: getCharges
methods.description: Returns a list of charges with specified month-day for testing invalid month-day validation errors.
